references.text: The context where Israel will eat their own children due to the distress of siege, as verse 55 continues to describe
Continuation of the same theme of extreme distress during a siege where parents refuse to share with their closest relatives
Earlier warning in the Torah that Israel will eat the flesh of their own sons and daughters as punishment for disobedience
The prophecy that people will eat each other's flesh during the siege of Jerusalem
The fulfillment of the curse when compassionate women cooked their own children during the siege of Jerusalem
Ezekiel's prophecy that fathers shall eat their children and children their fathers because of the sins of Jerusalem
Historical example of cannibalism during the siege of Samaria, where a mother ate her own child
